meta.designed_by: Archival (executing agent) — 2026-09-22, 针对第二轮新入库 50 篇出题
meta.grounding: 每题基于 results/r2_survey.json 三窗口真实正文与 A3c 判断件内容设计; gold_arxiv_id 为文档 slug 形式(斜杠已转连字符); gold_keywords 全部在论文正文中逐字出现且为正确答案应含词汇

questions.paper: AOAD-MAT: Transformer-based Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Model considering Agents' Order of Action Decisions
questions.question: Compared with prior Multi-Agent Transformer (MAT) models, what aspect of the agents' decision process does AOAD-MAT explicitly model?
questions.question_zh: 与既有 Multi-Agent Transformer 模型相比，AOAD-MAT 显式建模了智能体决策过程的哪个方面？

questions.paper: Instructive Dialogue Summarization with Query Aggregations
questions.question: What three-step approach does InstructDS use to synthesize high-quality training triples for query-based dialogue summarization?
questions.question_zh: InstructDS 用哪三步合成基于查询的对话摘要训练三元组？

questions.paper: EvoR: Evolving Retrieval for Code Generation
questions.question: In the EvoR pipeline for retrieval-augmented code generation, which two components evolve synchronously instead of staying static?
questions.question_zh: 在 EvoR 检索增强代码生成管线中，哪两个组成部分是同步演化的？

questions.paper: STRAND: Sequence-Conditioned Transport for Single-Cell Perturbations
questions.question: What does STRAND condition on to represent a genetic perturbation, instead of collapsing all interventions on the same gene into one representation?
questions.question_zh: STRAND 用什么来表征基因扰动，而不是把同一基因的不同干预折叠为同一表示？

questions.paper: Quantum error mitigation via matrix product operators
questions.question: What kind of errors between gates can the matrix product operator (MPO) error mitigation method characterize that typical techniques like quasi-probability decomposition ignore?
questions.question_zh: 矩阵乘积算子（MPO）错误缓解方法能刻画哪类准概率分解等典型方法会忽略的门间错误？

questions.paper: Dynamic electrical behavior of halide perovskite based solar cells
questions.question: What physical mechanism does the dynamic electrical model use to explain the hysteretic J-V characteristics of perovskite solar cells?
questions.question_zh: 动态电学模型用什么物理机理解释钙钛矿太阳能电池的 J-V 迟滞特性？

questions.paper: Epitope analysis for influenza vaccine design
questions.question: Which season's influenza vaccine does the statistical-mechanics epitope analysis explain as ineffective in the United States, and through what drift mechanism?
questions.question_zh: 统计力学表位分析解释了美国哪一年的流感疫苗失效？通过什么漂移机制？

questions.paper: Detection of Prosodic Boundaries in Speech Using Wav2Vec 2.0
questions.question: Using only what kind of information, and reaching what accuracy, does the wav2vec 2.0 approach detect within-sentence prosodic boundaries on Czech broadcast news?
questions.question_zh: wav2vec 2.0 仅利用什么信息、在捷克广播新闻上达到多少准确率检测句内韵律边界？

questions.paper: Optimal trap cropping investments to maximize agricultural yield
questions.question: In the trap-cropping optimization framework, roughly what share of the field should be allocated to trap plants when they are 5 to 25 times more attractive than the cash plant?
questions.question_zh: 在诱虫作物优化框架中，当诱虫植物吸引力是经济作物 5 到 25 倍时，约应占田块多大比例？

questions.paper: On the Extrapolation of Generative Adversarial Networks for downscaling precipitation extremes in warmer climates
questions.question: Beyond which percentile of precipitation did the GAN clearly outperform the deterministic baseline in capturing the climate-change wetting signal?
questions.question_zh: 在降水的哪个分位数之外，GAN 在捕捉气候变化湿化信号上明显优于确定性基线？
